title: Enterprise Live Runtime Expansion
globalSafetyRules: Implement one subphase at a time.
Do not modify projects/**, careloop/**, generated app Sources/Tests, providers/**, tools/**, worker-runtime/**, deploy/**, release/**, exports/**, packages/**, or .env*.
P93.1 is contract-only and must not modify db/** or enable DB writes.
Later P93 subphases may only enable governed local SQLite CRUD where explicitly scoped.

Do not enable provider/model calls, agent dispatch, tool execution, worker execution, project creation, project mutation, hosted DBs, network calls, deploy, release, export, package creation, or provider spend.
Do not expose DemoApp in full Command Center.
Do not show project/private raw IDs in primary UX.
Do not invent fake working actions.

subphases.objective: Define the P93 enterprise live-runtime expansion contract for governed local SQLite CRUD without enabling mutation yet.

expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.futureDataShape: Result envelope with schemaVersion, currentState, runtimeMode, dbMode, entityLanes[], allowedLocalCrudOperations[], forbiddenOperations[], mutationGate, runtimeFlags, nextAction, blockers, disabledReason, ownerCapability, evidenceRefs, activityLocation, costImpact, commandCenterVisible, and all non-scoped unsafe runtime flags false.

subphases.commandCenterUxRequirements: Preserve current Command Center UX. Later P93 UX must show DB-backed runtime state, current state, next action, blockers, disabled reason, owner capability, evidence/activity location, and cost impact without raw JSON, raw logs, raw policy dumps, DemoApp, raw private IDs, or fake runnable actions.
playwrightTests: No Playwright update in P93.1 because no UI files change.
P93 Command Center UX subphase must add focused coverage.
finalSafetyChecks: Confirm no provider/model calls, agent dispatch, tool/worker execution, project creation, project mutation, hosted DB, network, deploy, release, export, package, or spend is enabled.
gitCommands: git commit -m "feat(nexus): define enterprise live runtime expansion"
finalResponseChecklist: Docs, roadmap, and OS phase status updates
